title: First-wave LIHTC state-pack controlled source intake
activation_policy: NO_STATE_PACK_MAY_ACTIVATE_FROM_THIS_MANIFEST. Every source must be downloaded from its official publisher, byte-hashed, content-validated, reconciled for currency and supersession, mapped to deterministic fixtures, and independently approved before a release is eligible.
shared_release_requirements: Exact official source bytes and SHA-256 identity
Publisher, version, publication/effective date, and retrieval timestamp
Page-cited deterministic rules with positive, negative, boundary, layered-program, and supersession fixtures
Property-specific authority, limits, and regulatory-agreement terms remain separately verified

states.scope: LIHTC compliance monitoring only; excludes allocation scoring and property-specific regulatory-agreement terms
